1.title: Threat Protection with Microsoft Defender XDR
1.text: Welcome to Module ten: Threat Protection with Microsoft Defender X D R. It covers the exam area Capabilities of Microsoft security solutions. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do seven things. Describe Microsoft Defender X D R services. Describe Microsoft Defender for Office three sixty-five. Describe Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Describe Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps. Describe Microsoft Defender for Identity. Describe Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Capabilities of Microsoft security solutions (thirty-five to forty percent). Exam format: forty-five minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official S C nine hundred study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-one, two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Defender XDR: the idea
1.text: Defender X D R: the idea. Extended detection and response (X D R) joins signals from many protection areas so related attacks appear as one incident. Microsoft Defender X D R (formerly Microsoft three sixty-five Defender) combines these products. Defender for Office three sixty-five. Email and collaboration (Outlook, Teams, Share Point, One Drive). Defender for Endpoint. Devices (Windows, mac O S, Linux, i O S, Android). Defender for Identity. On-premises Active Directory identities and signals. Defender for Cloud Apps. Cloud apps (a cas bee), including shadow I T. Microsoft Entra I D Protection. Identity risk signals. Defender Vulnerability Management. Weaknesses in devices and apps.

1.title: Defender XDR: the idea, continued
1.text: Defender X D R: the idea. The figure shows this: Defender X D R joins email, devices, identities and cloud apps into one incident view.

1.title: Defender XDR: the idea, continued
1.text: Defender X D R: the idea. Core X D R features: correlated incidents, automatic attack disruption, advanced hunting, and automated investigation and response (A I R). Exam tip: X D R equals one incident across email, endpoints, identities and apps. Old name: Microsoft three sixty-five Defender. Do not mix up Defender X D R (threat protection for workplace) and Defender for Cloud (Azure and multicloud workloads).

1.title: Defender for Office 365
1.text: Defender for Office three sixty-five. Protects email and collaboration against phishing, malware, business email compromise and malicious links and attachments. Safe Links. Checks links when clicked (time of click). Safe Attachments. Opens attachments in a sandbox before delivery. Anti-phishing. Detects impersonation and spoofing, using machine learning. Attack simulation training. Simulated phishing to train users. Threat Explorer and automated investigation. Investigate and remediate threats.

1.title: Defender for Endpoint
1.text: Defender for Endpoint. An enterprise endpoint security platform that prevents, detects, investigates and responds to threats on devices. Next-generation protection. Antivirus and antimalware. Endpoint detection and response (E D R). Detects advanced attacks and shows the attack story. Attack surface reduction. Rules that block risky behavior. Automated investigation and remediation. Fixes threats automatically. Device isolation. Cut an infected device off the network. Threat and vulnerability information. Links to Defender Vulnerability Management.

1.title: Defender for Cloud Apps
1.text: Defender for Cloud Apps. A cloud access security broker (cas bee) that gives visibility and control over cloud apps and data. Cloud Discovery. Finds apps in use, including shadow I T, and rates their risk. Information protection. Finds and protects sensitive data in cloud apps. Threat protection. Detects anomalous behavior and compromised accounts. Policies and Conditional Access App Control. Real-time session monitoring and limits. App connectors. Connect to apps through A P Is. Exam tip: Shadow I T (unsanctioned cloud apps) equals Defender for Cloud Apps or cas bee or Cloud Discovery.

1.title: Defender for Identity
1.text: Defender for Identity. Uses signals from on-premises Active Directory (domain controllers) to detect compromised identities and advanced threats, such as pass-the-hash, reconnaissance, lateral movement and privilege escalation. It uses sensors installed on domain controllers. Exam tip: On-premises A D attacks and lateral movement equals Defender for Identity. Cloud sign-in risk equals Entra I D Protection.

1.title: Defender Vulnerability Management
1.text: Defender Vulnerability Management. Continuously discovers, prioritizes and helps remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across devices, applications and certificates, with risk-based prioritization, a software inventory, security baselines and remediation tracking. It is included in Defender for Endpoint (full capabilities as an add-on).

1.title: Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence
1.text: Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence. Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence (Defender T I) gives analysts insight into threat actors, infrastructure and tactics (Microsoft Threat Intelligence), helping them investigate and understand attackers. Microsoft's threat intelligence also feeds all Defender products.

1.title: The Microsoft Defender portal
1.text: The Microsoft Defender portal. The Microsoft Defender portal (security.microsoft.com) is the single place to work with X D R products: incidents and alerts, hunting, actions and submissions, threat intelligence, reports, and secure score for Microsoft three sixty-five. It now also hosts Microsoft Sentinel (unified security operations).

1.title: The Microsoft Defender portal, continued
1.text: The Microsoft Defender portal. The figure shows this: The Defender portal brings incidents, hunting, threat intelligence and Sentinel into one place.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors wants to detonate email attachments in a sandbox before they reach users. Which feature does this? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Safe Attachments in Defender for Office three sixty-five. Safe Attachments opens attachments in a sandbox before delivery.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. An administrator needs to find which unsanctioned cloud apps employees use. Which product helps? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Defender for Cloud Apps. Cloud Discovery in Defender for Cloud Apps finds shadow I T.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which product detects attacks such as pass-the-hash on on-premises Active Directory? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Defender for Identity. Defender for Identity monitors domain controllers for identity threats.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which capability lets an administrator isolate an infected laptop from the network? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Defender for Endpoint. Defender for Endpoint can isolate devices.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. What was Microsoft Defender X D R called before? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Microsoft three sixty-five Defender. Microsoft three sixty-five Defender was renamed Microsoft Defender X D R.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which capability prioritizes software weaknesses on devices by risk? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Defender Vulnerability Management. Defender Vulnerability Management discovers and prioritizes vulnerabilities.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What does X D R stand for? Answer: Extended detection and response. Question two. What does Safe Links do? Answer: Checks links at the time of click. Question three. What does cas bee stand for? Answer: Cloud access security broker.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Where does Defender for Identity get signals? Answer: On-premises Active Directory domain controllers. Question five. What is Defender Threat Intelligence for? Answer: Insight into threat actors and their methods. Question six. What is the Defender portal? Answer: The single portal for X D R incidents, hunting and more.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Defender X D R: formerly Microsoft three sixty-five Defender; Office three sixty-five, Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps combined into incidents. Office three sixty-five: Safe Links, Safe Attachments, anti-phishing, attack simulation. Endpoint: antivirus, E D R, attack surface reduction, isolation. Cloud Apps: cas bee; Cloud Discovery; shadow I T. Identity: on-premises A D sensors; pass-the-hash, lateral movement. Vulnerability Management and Threat Intelligence: prioritize weaknesses; threat actor insight. Defender portal: single place for incidents, hunting, reports; hosts Sentinel. In the next module, we continue the course.
